detail.goal: look up member 12345 and read their savings balance

detail.note: the entry page exposed only 11 perceivable node(s) (1 controls). That usually means a bot wall, a consent gate, or a canvas-rendered app with no accessibility tree

detail.why: The Member ID textbox is the input for the member lookup; typing the target member number here parameterizes the search on replay.

detail.target: button named "Search" follows "Search Type" in frame "main"
detail.why: Submits the Member Inquiry form to load the member record for the ID entered above.
The balance cell in the same row as the "Savings" label in the Account/Balance table — anchored to the row label rather than position, so it stays correct if account rows are reordered or added.
Confirms the loaded record matches the searched member number, guarding against a stale or mismatched detail page on replay.
Human-readable confirmation of whose balance was read, useful when the recorded step is replayed with a different member ID.

detail.summary:
Looked up member 12345 via Member Inquiry (Search Type: Member Number) and read the savings balance from the Member Detail screen.

- Member: Sarah Chen (ID 12345), Status: Active
- Savings balance: $4,182.55 (Checking, shown alongside, is $1,204.10)

Recorded outputs: savingsBalance, memberId, memberName. The savings figure is located by the balance cell in the same row as the "Savings" label, so it survives reordering or addition of account rows. Checkpoint is the stable "Member Detail" heading rather than any balance value.
